role: Physically realizable passive circuit benchmark, with published CPE hardware scale; no measurements of the new three-node circuit are claimed.

primary_source.title: Integer-and Fractional-Order Integral and Derivative Two-Port Summations: Practical Design Considerations
primary_source.phase_band_status: Theoretical operational bandwidth reported for passive RC design; not a statement that arbitrary transient waveforms have a 2 percent error.

base_emulator.connection: Rp and Cp in parallel with ten series-RC branches, all across CPE terminals.
base_emulator.extraction_status: All component values visually checked on rendered Figure 2(a).

primary_source.experimental_status: The paper used this alpha and pseudo-capacitance in experimentally tested two-port circuits; its passive circuit figure is a finite-band CPE realization, not an exact fractional element.

proposed_new_circuit_design.scaling_rule: For node scale s: multiply every capacitor (including Cp) by s and divide every resistor (including Rp) by s. This multiplies exact emulator admittance by s while keeping each RC time constant fixed.
proposed_new_circuit_design.initialization: All capacitor/node voltages zero for t<=0; causal step current at t=0. This uses zero prehistory and avoids arbitrary nonzero Caputo initialization.
proposed_new_circuit_design.parameter_status: All inter-node/shunt resistors, Q scales, input current, graph and observation window are explicit new design choices. They are not fitted measurements.
proposed_new_circuit_design.model_comparison_recommendation: Compare ideal fractional reference against the exact zero-state response of the 33-state finite RC network, separately from the L1 numerical errors.
proposed_new_circuit_design.frequency_band_limitation: A switched current is not band limited. Reciprocal endpoint frequencies are not a certified transient-validity window. Modal frequencies inside the design band motivate this benchmark; the finite-RC comparison quantifies model discrepancy separately.
proposed_new_circuit_design.characteristic_modal_frequencies_definit: eigenvalues lambda of Q^(-1/2) K Q^(-1/2), with f=lambda^(1/alpha)/(2*pi); all lie inside the stated 1Hz--3MHz CPE design band.
proposed_new_circuit_design.T_selection: T=(0.224 s^(1/2))^2=0.050176 s gives dyadic nondimensional masses, simplifying exact grid arithmetic.
